$comment: Projects published to https://docs.jjsm.science by .github/workflows/wikijs-docs.yml.
One entry per docs folder in this repo.
name      job label, and the value of the 'project' input for a manual run
src       docs folder; <src>/README.md (or index.md) becomes the page at 'prefix'
locales   optional, e.g. "en,es": <src>/en/, <src>/es/ each publish to that Wiki.js locale
(/es/<prefix>/...); files with the same path are linked as translations
an optional _sidebar.json in a docs folder is that locale's sidebar on the 'prefix' page;
edits made on the wiki are kept unless the file changed too (then the file wins);
wikijs_sync.py --pull-sidebar copies the wiki's sidebars back into the files
prefix    wiki path prefix, e.g. physics/fusion/asdex-upgrade -> docs.jjsm.science/physics/fusion/asdex-upgrade
tags      comma-separated tags added to every page of this project
watch     path prefixes that trigger a publish on push (default: [src])
notebooks true if src holds .ipynb/.qmd files -> sets up Quarto
execute   true to run the notebooks before rendering (needs 'install')
install   shell command that installs what the notebooks import (run from the repo root)
pagetools false to drop the GitHub/Edit/Cite block (the links 404 on a private repo)
Before a NEW prefix publishes: in Wiki.js, give the sync user's group a page rule
allowing read/write/manage pages on a path STARTING WITH that prefix, or the run
fails with 403 'You are not allowed to create a page here.'
With locales, the rule must cover every one of them (leave its locales empty, or list them all).
Wiki.js also slugifies paths on save (aurora_lbo -> aurora-lbo); wikijs_sync.py
matches that, so a file with _ in its name is fine.
